svg.title: JTP: representation, invoice authority and the later reported payment
svg.desc: English evidence companion to the actors and payment-route visual. Two messages dated 1 June 2020 were addressed to the client team. JTP stated that the administrator knew he no longer held the client's venia. A separate message, whose sender is withheld, said JTP was no longer LPB's lawyer and that no invoice to the administrator should be authorised until matters were clarified. Direct delivery of that instruction to the administrator is not established by these copies. The final proposal was rejected on 12 June 2020. The administrator later reported a 26,750 euro payment in July 2020. Source, payment authority, knowledge and causal effect remain questions for investigation.
svg.text: POR DERECHO · CRIMINAL / PROSECUTORIAL EVIDENCE
JTP: representation and
authority to invoice
Read this source record alongside the actors and payment-route image.
ONE CONNECTED HISTORY · DISTINCT DATES AND PROOF
ONA-led funded-exit architecture → 7 June 2018 control event
→ defence continuity → 2020 fee / authority / payment questions
1 June 2020 · Two correspondence records
A · JTP’S OWN STATEMENT TO THE CLIENT TEAM
JTP stated that the AC knew he no longer held the client’s venia.
This records what JTP said about the AC’s knowledge.
It is not an independently authenticated acknowledgement by the AC.
B · CLIENT-TEAM MESSAGE · SENDER WITHHELD
JTP was no longer LPB’s lawyer.
No invoice to the AC was to be authorised
until the position with the AC had been clarified.
Faithful translated summary, not a composite direct quotation.
RECIPIENT / DELIVERY BOUNDARY
These recovered messages were addressed to the client team, not to the AC.
Separate proof that the AC received the no-invoice instruction remains open.
12 JUNE 2020
Final fee proposal expressly rejected.
A separate later event, not the date
of the two messages above.
JULY 2020 · REPORTED PAYMENT
€26,750 to JTP
Listed as paid in the AC’s report
dated 21 July 2021.
What must the investigation reconcile?
Source of funds · specific authority · disclosure · knowledge · effect
CAM €400,000 → estate control → later JTP payment: matched bank trace open.
A payment entry or client-side instruction alone does not establish criminal liability.
